note: Inputs are the files in vectors/, used byte for byte. 'digest' is the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the canonical form; 'sameAs' names a vector with the same digest.

ACD-01.description: Reviewed draft: a preserved-snapshot Bundle, pretty-printed; decimal 5.0, non-ASCII names, a tab, a quotation mark, a solidus and a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane

ACD-02.description: ACD-01 minified, with members in a different order and non-ASCII characters and the solidus written as escape sequences

ACD-03.description: ACD-01 attested by a person: new Bundle id, identifier and timestamp, Composition.attester and a Practitioner entry referenced only by it

ACD-04.description: ACD-01 attested by the custodian organisation: its entry is also referenced by Composition.custodian and is kept

ACD-05.description: Variant draft whose author is a Practitioner

ACD-06.description: ACD-05 attested by its author: the Practitioner entry is referenced elsewhere and is kept

ACD-07.description: ACD-01 with the dose written 5 instead of 5.0: the number's lexical form is significant

ACD-09.description: ACD-01 with a clinical change to the dosage text

ACD-11.description: Unpaired surrogate in a string: rejected
